gui_forms::MenuStrip.summary: MenuStrip is the retained top-level menu coordinator. It lays out root items, tracks hot and active identities, transfers navigation across an owned ContextMenu, supports mnemonic and semantic entry, and exposes caller-controlled item padding while keeping invocation and open-state events ordered.
remarks: A retained focusable menu bar. Root items are laid out by the strip; popup rows share `Command` authority with pointer, keyboard, and semantic activation through an owned `ContextMenu`.
`use_mnemonic` removes markers from top-level width, paint, and semantics; duplicate top-level mnemonics cycle deterministically.
Overflow and hosted ToolStrip controls remain open.
gui_forms::MenuStrip.ownership: Created by the application as a `Control::Ptr` (`std::shared_ptr<Control>`). A parent holds its children strongly and a child holds its parent weakly; cycles, duplicate stable IDs, cross-window reparenting, and disposed children are rejected. Disposal through `Component::dispose()` is synchronous and idempotent and revokes owned subscriptions before subclass teardown.
gui_forms::MenuStrip.threading: UI-thread affine. Read and mutate on the owning Window's UI thread; wrong-thread mutation is rejected by the Window access guards (`Window::check_access` and `Window::verify_access`). The type is not internally synchronized.
gui_forms::MenuStrip.availability: Renderer-neutral core (`gui_forms_controls`). Available wherever the GUI.Forms core builds: the macOS AppKit host, the Windows Win32 host, and the opt-in Linux X11 host. The public API is not yet stable.
